manifest.name: channel-import-state
manifest.description: Progressive initial history import of one channel connection (backlog:66282d13d81c). One row per connection: the opaque provider cursor the next page resumes from, the window the run covers, and the phase plus the failure code. The row keeps no counters: the progress surface counts the channel-import-outcome rows carrying this row's sourceKey (one COUNT per state), so the number is always the rows themselves and no racing advance or crash retry can drift it.

migrations.name: create_channel_import_states
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS channel_import_states (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  space_id TEXT,
  connection_key TEXT,
  adapter TEXT,
  adapter_version INTEGER,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('running', 'done')),
  window_start TEXT,
  next_page_token TEXT,
  started_at TEXT,
  finished_at TEXT,
  last_error_code TEXT,
  last_error_reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS channel_import_states_space_id ON channel_import_states(space_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS channel_import_states_connection_key ON channel_import_states(connection_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS channel_import_states_status ON channel_import_states(status);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_channel_import_states
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."channel_import_states" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "space_id" TEXT,
  "connection_key" TEXT,
  "adapter" TEXT,
  "adapter_version" BIGINT,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('running', 'done')),
  "window_start" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "next_page_token" TEXT,
  "started_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "finished_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "last_error_code" TEXT,
  "last_error_reason" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "channel_import_states_space_id"
  ON "accordo"."channel_import_states"("space_id");

CREATE INDEX "channel_import_states_connection_key"
  ON "accordo"."channel_import_states"("connection_key");

CREATE INDEX "channel_import_states_status"
  ON "accordo"."channel_import_states"("status");
